open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Invariant ledger overview
open_points.text: `invariant_ledger.json` is the evidence of 2026-07-19 whose rows were distributed into the decisions (Status above).
open_points.question: Which text is the authoritative current set of formal invariants when the historical ledger, the unspecified "Status above", and the decisions differ?
options: Only the decisions' Formal invariants are current; the ledger is historical evidence.
The ledger rows remain formal invariants unless the referenced status explicitly removes them.
The current set is a merge of the ledger and decisions.
open_points.default_guess: Treat only the decisions' Formal invariants as current and use the ledger solely as historical evidence.

witness.initial: A ledger row contains an email-challenge invariant that later decisions omit.
events: An implementer determines which invariants the authentication flow must enforce.
A staff member attempts to sign in without completing an email challenge.
outcomes: The implementer treats the ledger as historical and permits sign-in based only on active status.
The implementer treats the retained ledger row as normative and requires or checks an email challenge.
witness.observer: The staff member attempting to sign in

open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Invariant ledger overview
open_points.text: It keeps wording the owner withdrew with the email challenges (R0-23): the verified email of INV-001 and INV-014
open_points.question: Was only challenge-dependent verified-email wording in INV-001 and INV-014 withdrawn, or were the invariants concerning the recorded "email verified" mark also withdrawn despite R0-20 and R0-23 requiring that mark to be set and shown?
options: Only verification-as-a-challenge or authorization condition was withdrawn; invariants for recording, setting, and showing the mark remain.
All verified-email requirements in INV-001 and INV-014 were withdrawn.
INV-001 and INV-014 must be replaced by newly numbered invariants for the retained inert mark.
open_points.default_guess: Preserve invariants requiring the inert mark to be recorded, set by the named operations, and shown, while removing every challenge or authorization consequence.

witness.initial: A staff account has an unset recorded email-verified mark.
events: An administrator performs the recovery override and supplies a replacement login email.
The staff member or administrator opens the account view.
outcomes: R0-20 and R0-23 require the override to set the mark and the view to show it.
Reading the verified-email wording of INV-001 and INV-014 as wholly withdrawn permits omitting the mark update or its display.
witness.observer: The person viewing the staff account

open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Invariant ledger overview
open_points.text: INV-001…INV-015 | IAM: sessions, capabilities, secrets (INV-010…INV-013 and INV-016, the email challenges, removed 2026-11-07, R0-23)
open_points.question: Why is INV-016 described inside the INV-001…INV-015 row, and does it belong to that row's area, owning responsibilities, and landing or have no current assignment because it was removed?
options: INV-016 is historical-only and intentionally has no current owner or landing.
The range should be INV-001…INV-016, so INV-016 inherits this row's area, responsibilities, and landing.
INV-016 belongs to a different omitted row or decision.
open_points.default_guess: Treat INV-016 as a removed historical row with no current owner or landing, and exclude it from the current formal-invariant set.
